raw_tokens.value: Humans have come to shape the face of Golarion because they are inveterate innovators. Humans with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft checks to independently research spells, create magic items they have never encountered before, and identify unique magical effects. They also gain a +2 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to persuade others to adopt a new ideology or further the cause of discovery and progress.
This racial trait replaces skilled.|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Human ~ Innovative
SkillBonus|+2 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to persuade others to adopt a new ideology or further the cause of discovery and progress.
